worldcombat.skill.doublehit.summary: Sweep the tail left and right from a standstill: the first sweep drives targets aside along the arc and the second catches them on the return. Arc style covers wider with a bigger shove and can catch several targets; straight style sweeps both times in one direction, narrower and harder per sweep.
worldcombat.skill.doublehit.use.0: Sweep the tail once to each side from a standstill
worldcombat.skill.doublehit.use.1: Push a small forward patch of foes back and forth along the arc
worldcombat.skill.doublehit.use.2: Use the wide arc to clear foes pressed against you
Two standing tail sweeps: each sweep deals about %1$s physical damage to enemies in the forward sector, with tail reach %2$s blocks and a %3$s-degree sweep; each sweep hits up to %4$s targets, and each target at most once per sweep.
Gap between sweeps %1$s; each sweep shoves the target %2$s blocks along the sweeping direction.
worldcombat.skill.doublehit.arc.on: Arc style now: the tail sweeps one way then returns the other, with a wider angle and a bigger lateral shove, pushing targets one way on the first sweep and the other way on the return; each sweep is lighter.
worldcombat.skill.doublehit.arc.off: Straight style now: both sweeps go the same way, narrower and more focused, harder per sweep, pushing targets steadily away in one direction.
worldcombat.skill.doublehit.timing: Range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s, recovery %3$s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.doublehit.growth.0: From level %1$s the power per sweep rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.doublehit.growth.1: From level %1$s the power per sweep is %2$s and the lateral shove is %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.doublehit.growth.2: From level %1$s the power per sweep rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.doublehit.preference.a: On (return sweep): the tail sweeps one way then returns the other, with x1.1 angle and a x1.2 lateral shove, pushing targets one way then the other; each sweep is x0.9. Off (straight): both sweeps go the same way at x0.62 angle, narrower and more focused, x1.15 per sweep, pushing targets steadily away in one direction.
Beyond this distance it will not sweep and closes in first.
When on, it sweeps more readily when other enemies stand near the target, because the wide arc can catch several at once; when off, it ranks like an ordinary melee attack.
When on, the companion may leave its post to sweep; when off, it only casts at what it can reach from where it stands.
